title: The public Space page is Dawn's page in full, in Frequency styles: white bordered cards on the cream ground, back link under the cover, no facts band
detail: Daniel 2026-10-19 (item 1) and 2026-10-20: the public Space page was a great layout in Dawn; the first pass (LIVE-1029) only covered the header. The body now matches Dawn in Frequency tokens: cover, then the way back, name and tagline, tabs, then the owner's blocks in Dawn's order, each card solid white with a hairline on the canvas ground, and the front door at the foot. Fixed from a render of both designs: the container was wider than a 390px phone (width:100% on .fqs-wrap), the site kit's .block rule turned Tailwind's block spans in Team cards into nested gradient cards, and the info and offering cards were washed-out glass. The extra key-facts band under the page is gone (Dawn had none; where, when and contact are the blocks' own cards). No migration.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=[];const p=fs.readFileSync('app/(public)/spaces/[slug]/page.tsx','utf8');const c=fs.readFileSync('app/themes/frequency/space-page.css','utf8');if(p.includes('<FqSpaceFacts'))bad.push('public page draws the facts band again');if(!c.includes('.fqs-public>.fqs-wrap{width:100%'))bad.push('container can overflow a phone');if(!c.includes('.block:not(.rounded-card)'))bad.push('site kit .block leaks into Team cards');if(/\\[data-fq=\"panel\"\\]\\s*\\{[^}]*glass/.test(c))bad.push('info cards are glass again');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1094: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the facts band returns, the phone overflow fix is lost, the .block leak returns, or info cards go back to glass.
